title: Quasisymmetric universality, quasi-isometric classification and topological rigidity of Kleinian groups
summary: We study the quasisymmetric classification of limit sets of Kleinian groups and obtain a characterization of those geometrically finite limit sets that are quasisymmetrically universal. This allows us to obtain a quasi-isometric classification of finitely generated Kleinian groups. We also obtain a classification of virtually topologically rigid geometrically finite Kleinian groups.
